Jev pricing and limits

Published September 15, 2026 · Updated September 17, 2026

Pricing

Jev is charged per input token. Output tokens are free. The current rate is $0.042 per million input tokens, which works out to $42 per billion.

There is no minimum commitment and no monthly fee. You pay for what you send.

Limits

Every request is bounded by two budgets. The state plus the longest single question must stay under 32,000 tokens, and the state plus all questions together must stay under 64,000 tokens.

  • 250,000 tokens per second
  • 1,200 requests per minute
  • Text input only

Notes on accuracy

Accuracy degrades as irrelevant material fills the state. Keep the state to what the questions need.

Jev reads dates as text, not as ordered values. Normalize them before asking.
